<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>倍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”
verses.heading: 用比喻的目的

verses.text: <ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>奥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>秘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mì</rt></ruby><ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>；<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>。”

“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>：<ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 解明撒种的比喻

verses.text: <ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>随<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suí</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>魔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mó</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>夺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duó</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>恐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>磐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pán</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>暂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>及<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>遇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>试<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>炼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liàn</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>退<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuì</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>荆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>虑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>钱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>财<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby>、<ruby>宴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yàn</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>挤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>熟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>粒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>土<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>持<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chí</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>诚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>良<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>忍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rěn</rt></ruby><ruby>耐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nài</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>结<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>。”

“<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>皿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>盖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>床<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>底<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>灯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>台<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tái</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>亮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 器皿下的灯

<ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hái</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>堂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>劳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">láo</rt></ruby><ruby>动<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby>！<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>救<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>哀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">āi</rt></ruby><ruby>哭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kū</rt></ruby><ruby>捶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuí</rt></ruby><ruby>胸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>哭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kū</rt></ruby>！<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>嗤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>笑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>，<ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>魂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hún</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>东<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xi</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>惊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>奇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>很<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hěn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>嘱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>齐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>、<ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>制<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>伏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>医<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby>，

verses.text: <ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>遣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>宣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>医<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>病<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>拐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>杖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>袋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dɑi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>银<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>件<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>褂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuà</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wú</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>抓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuā</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>忽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>喊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>；<ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>抽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chōu</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>沫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>难<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nán</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>诧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chà</rt></ruby><ruby>异<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>（“<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>”<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>威<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wēi</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby>”）。<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>希<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>奇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。”

verses.text: <ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bié</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>卜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>试<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>探<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tàn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>迹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>纷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>荒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>场<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎnɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>纷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>败<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby><ruby>落<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luò</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>纷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bié</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>卜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bié</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby><ruby>卜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>非<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>临<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lín</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>壮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>披<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pī</rt></ruby><ruby>挂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuà</rt></ruby><ruby>整<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhěnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>齐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kān</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>宅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>更<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>壮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>夺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duó</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>倚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>靠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>盔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuī</rt></ruby><ruby>甲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>兵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>器<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>赃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zānɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>相<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>合<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>收<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shōu</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>散<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

“<ruby>污<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wū</rt></ruby><ruby>鬼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>歇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jì</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>屋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>室<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>附<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>宣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuān</rt></ruby><ruby>扬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>。”

“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>朋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>友<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">you</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>体<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>做<ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 该怕的是谁

verses.text: <ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby>：<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>丢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diū</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>狱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>麻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">má</rt></ruby><ruby>雀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>卖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mài</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>银<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>忘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>麻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">má</rt></ruby><ruby>雀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>贵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby>！”

“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；
verses.heading: 在人的面前承认基督

verses.text: <ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>干<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby><ruby>犯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>赦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>独<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>亵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>渎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>总<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>赦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>堂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>府<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>虑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>请<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby>。”

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡe</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>！<ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>谨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>慎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>贪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tān</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>乎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hu</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>丰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>富<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>财<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhu</rt></ruby><ruby>田<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tián</rt></ruby><ruby>产<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>丰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>产<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>收<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shōu</rt></ruby><ruby>藏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>办<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？’

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>办<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby>：<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>拆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>另<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>盖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡài</rt></ruby><ruby>更<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>收<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shōu</rt></ruby><ruby>藏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>粮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>财<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rán</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>魂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hún</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>魂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hún</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>财<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>积<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>存<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cún</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>费<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèi</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yonɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>逸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>逸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！’

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wú</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>灵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>魂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hún</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？’

<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fán</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>积<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>财<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>富<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>忧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yōu</rt></ruby><ruby>虑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>体<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>忧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yōu</rt></ruby><ruby>虑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>穿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuān</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>；

verses.text: <ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>饮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>体<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>胜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>裳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shɑnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>乌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wū</rt></ruby><ruby>鸦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>收<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shōu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>仓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>库<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kù</rt></ruby>，　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>尚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>养<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huo</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>飞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēi</rt></ruby><ruby>鸟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>贵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>！

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>虑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>寿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>数<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>（<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>肘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>”）？

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>最<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>尚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>做，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>忧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yōu</rt></ruby><ruby>虑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǜ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>余<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？
