<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡe</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>娼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>妓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>吞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tūn</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>产<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>宰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>肥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">féi</rt></ruby><ruby>牛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niú</rt></ruby><ruby>犊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dú</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fù</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">er</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡe</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>、<ruby>失<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby>。’”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>财<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>浪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>费<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèi</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>财<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 不义的管家

verses.text: <ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>代<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>辞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cí</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>做<ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>？<ruby>锄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chú</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>讨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>欠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>债<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhài</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>欠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>少<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shɑo</rt></ruby>？’

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>篓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǒu</rt></ruby>（<ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>篓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>斤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby>）<ruby>油<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yóu</rt></ruby>。’<ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Guǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ná</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>账<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby>，<ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>五<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>祖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǔ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>罕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>悔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>改<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎi</rt></ruby>。’

<mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>罕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>劝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quàn</rt></ruby>。’”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>绊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>绊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>祸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>磨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mò</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>拴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuān</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>颈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>项<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>丢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diū</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>强<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>绊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>谨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>慎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby>！<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>劝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quàn</rt></ruby><ruby>戒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>懊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>悔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>饶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ráo</rt></ruby><ruby>恕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>倘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>次<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>次<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>转<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>懊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ào</rt></ruby><ruby>悔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>’，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>总<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>饶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ráo</rt></ruby><ruby>恕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>增<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>粒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>芥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>菜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cài</rt></ruby><ruby>种<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǒnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>棵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kē</rt></ruby><ruby>桑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>树<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>拔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bá</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>根<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>栽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>海<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>’，<ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>耕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>放<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>田<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tián</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby>’<ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>晚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>束<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>伺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby>’<ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>吩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>咐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>做，<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xie</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby>：“　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>几<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>灰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huī</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 寡妇和法官的比喻

verses.text: <ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>某<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>寡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>伸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>冤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuān</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>准<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>虽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suī</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>寡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby><ruby>烦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>扰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>伸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>冤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuān</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>缠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chán</rt></ruby><ruby>磨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mó</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>！’”

<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>选<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>昼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhòu</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>吁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>纵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>忍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rěn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>岂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>终<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>久<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>伸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>冤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuān</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>快<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>伸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>冤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuān</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rán</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>，<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>遇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>德<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>向<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>仗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>藐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>视<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby>，
verses.heading: 法利赛人和税吏的祷告

verses.text: <ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby>：<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>税<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>吏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby>，<ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>言<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>语<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>感<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>勒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>索<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby>、<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>、<ruby>奸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>淫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡe</rt></ruby><ruby>税<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>吏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>礼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bài</rt></ruby><ruby>禁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>食<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>次<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>捐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">juān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>税<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>吏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby>，<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>举<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>目<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mù</rt></ruby><ruby>望<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>敢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>捶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuí</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>胸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>怜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡe</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>！’

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>算<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>义<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>降<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>卑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>卑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>升<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby>。”

verses.heading: 耶稣为小孩祝福

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>让<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>禁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>止<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>实<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>承<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>良<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>该<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāi</rt></ruby>做<ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>承<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>永<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>？”
verses.heading: 富足的官寻求永生之道

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>良<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>？<ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chú</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>良<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>诫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>命<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>奸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>淫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>偷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tōu</rt></ruby><ruby>盗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>；<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>假<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>孝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiào</rt></ruby><ruby>敬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>母<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǔ</rt></ruby>。’”

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>遵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>缺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quē</rt></ruby><ruby>少<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>件<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>：<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>变<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>卖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>穷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>财<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>宝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>甚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shèn</rt></ruby><ruby>忧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yōu</rt></ruby><ruby>愁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>很<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hěn</rt></ruby><ruby>富<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>足<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zú</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>懂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǒnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby><ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>藏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>瞎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiā</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>旁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>讨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>锭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>银<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>锭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby>！<ruby>良<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>善<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>最<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>小<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>忠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>锭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>凡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fán</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>夺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duó</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yē</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bó</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bó</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>尼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ní</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>橄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>榄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>村<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cūn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>匹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>驴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǘ</rt></ruby><ruby>驹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>拴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuān</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>骑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>解<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>牵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>解<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。’”

<ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>遇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>解<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>驴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǘ</rt></ruby><ruby>驹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>解<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>驴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǘ</rt></ruby><ruby>驹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby>做<ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>牵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiān</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby><ruby>搭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dā</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>扶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>骑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby><ruby>铺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pū</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>路<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lù</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>冷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lěnɡ</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>橄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>榄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>异<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>乐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lè</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>赞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zàn</rt></ruby><ruby>美<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>奉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>颂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>！<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zài</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>荣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>光<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuānɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>几<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>赛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>责<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zé</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>闭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>，<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>呼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hū</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bu</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>关<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>系<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>平<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>安<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>；<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>奈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nài</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>隐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐn</rt></ruby><ruby>藏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>眼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>扫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>块<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>眷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">juàn</rt></ruby><ruby>顾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>。”
