verses.text: <ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby>’，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>它<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>贼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zéi</rt></ruby><ruby>窝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wō</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。<ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fá</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>侧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cè</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>讲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>福<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>音<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，

verses.text: <ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>仗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>？<ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>句<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>洗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>礼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>？<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>商<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>议<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>‘<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>’，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？’

<ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>‘<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>’，<ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>仗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>柄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby>做<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>喻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>栽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>葡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>萄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tɑo</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby>，<ruby>租<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zū</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>久<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǔ</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>纳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>果<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；<ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>竟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>凌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">línɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>辱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>推<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuī</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>办<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bàn</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>爱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ài</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>者<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhě</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>尊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zūn</rt></ruby><ruby>敬<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>料<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>户<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hù</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>商<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liɑnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>承<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>产<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>吧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>产<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>归<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuī</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>！’

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>推<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tuī</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>葡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>萄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tɑo</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>葡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>萄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tɑo</rt></ruby><ruby>园<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>处<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？

<ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>该<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>几<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：

verses.text: “<ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>！<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡē</rt></ruby><ruby>哥<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡe</rt></ruby><ruby>生<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby>、<ruby>第<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>孩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>妇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>妻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>七<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qī</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>她<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>嫁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jià</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>惟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>算<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>配<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pèi</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>娶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>嫁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jià</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>复<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>摩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mó</rt></ruby><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>荆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>篇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">piān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>亚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yà</rt></ruby><ruby>伯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bó</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>罕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎn</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>示<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>明<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>白<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>原<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuán</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>乃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>（“<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>”<ruby>或<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>“<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>”），<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>活<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huó</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>几<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>敢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？
verses.heading: 大卫子孙的问题

verses.text: <ruby>诗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shī</rt></ruby><ruby>篇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">piān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biɑn</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>仇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>敌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dí</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>脚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>凳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dènɡ</rt></ruby>。’

<mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>既<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dà</rt></ruby><ruby>卫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>孙<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sūn</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>警<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>醒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>祈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>逃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">táo</rt></ruby><ruby>避<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>站<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhàn</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>教<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>训<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xùn</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>，<ruby>每<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">měi</rt></ruby><ruby>夜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>橄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>榄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>宿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sù</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>清<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>早<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>圣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>讲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chú</rt></ruby><ruby>酵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>逾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby>，<ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 杀害耶稣的阴谋

verses.text: <ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>法<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>才<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>杀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shā</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>惧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>怕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pà</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>略<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lüè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>守<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>殿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>官<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>商<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liɑnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>怎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zěn</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>欢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huān</rt></ruby><ruby>喜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>银<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>允<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>找<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>机<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>趁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chèn</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>交<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Chú</rt></ruby><ruby>酵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby>，<ruby>须<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>宰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>逾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>羊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 预备逾越节的筵席

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark>、<mark class="pn"><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>翰<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>逾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>筵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yào</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>城<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>瓶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>迎<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>进<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>夫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fū</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：<ruby>客<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>房<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>逾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>筵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby>。’

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>指<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>摆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>整<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhěnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>齐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>楼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lóu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>遇<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>备<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>逾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>筵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby>。
