verses.heading: 设立主的晚餐

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>很<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hěn</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>先<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiān</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>逾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>节<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>筵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>筵<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yán</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>接<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiē</rt></ruby><ruby>过<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuò</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>祝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡe</rt></ruby>，<ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>家<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>分<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēn</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>葡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>萄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tɑo</rt></ruby><ruby>汁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>等<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">děnɡ</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>饼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>祝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>谢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiè</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>擘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bāi</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>递<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>体<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>舍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shě</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>行<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xínɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>记<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>念<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">niàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>饭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>拿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ná</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>立<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>新<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>流<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kàn</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>卖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>手<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>桌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuō</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>固<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>预<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yù</rt></ruby><ruby>定<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>世<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>卖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>祸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby>做<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>论<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lùn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>算<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suàn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 争论谁为大

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>外<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wài</rt></ruby><ruby>邦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>君<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>治<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>理<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>掌<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>管<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>称<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>恩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ēn</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>年<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nián</rt></ruby><ruby>幼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>首<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>领<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>倒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>侍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>谁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuí</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>？<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shì</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>侍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Rán</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fú</rt></ruby><ruby>侍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>磨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mó</rt></ruby><ruby>炼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liàn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fù</rt></ruby><ruby>赐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>席<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吃<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chī</rt></ruby><ruby>喝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hē</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>且<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiě</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>宝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>座<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>审<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shěn</rt></ruby><ruby>判<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pàn</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>支<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>派<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pài</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby></mark>！<mark class="pn"><ruby>西<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Xī</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby></mark>！<ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Sā</rt></ruby><ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>想<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>筛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>筛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shāi</rt></ruby><ruby>麦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mài</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>；
verses.heading: 预言彼得不认主

verses.text: <ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>已<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>祈<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>求<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiú</rt></ruby>，<ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>至<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhì</rt></ruby><ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yú</rt></ruby><ruby>失<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shī</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tóu</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>坚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>固<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>弟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>兄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiōnɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>监<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>同<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>死<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>甘<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡān</rt></ruby><ruby>心<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xīn</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>日<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rì</rt></ruby><ruby>鸡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>三<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sān</rt></ruby><ruby>次<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cì</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>认<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rèn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>差<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chāi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>钱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>囊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nánɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>袋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dɑi</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>鞋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xié</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>缺<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quē</rt></ruby><ruby>少<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby>。”
verses.heading: 钱囊、口袋、刀

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>钱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>囊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby>，<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>袋<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dɑi</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>可<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kě</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>卖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mài</rt></ruby><ruby>衣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>服<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fu</rt></ruby><ruby>买<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>经<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>写<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiě</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhe</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：‘<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>犯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fàn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby>。’<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>应<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>验<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yàn</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>关<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuān</rt></ruby><ruby>系<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>事<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>请<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>看<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kàn</rt></ruby>！<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>两<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>够<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gòu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>照<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhào</rt></ruby><ruby>常<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>往<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>橄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>榄<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>山<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>跟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡēn</rt></ruby><ruby>随<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suí</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 在橄榄山上祷告

verses.text: <ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>方<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fɑnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>迷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mí</rt></ruby><ruby>惑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>于<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yú</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>约<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuē</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>扔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>块<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuài</rt></ruby><ruby>石<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>跪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuì</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>父<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Fù</rt></ruby><ruby>啊<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɑ</rt></ruby>！<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>愿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuàn</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>杯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bēi</rt></ruby><ruby>撤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chè</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>然<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rán</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby>，<ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby>，<ruby>只<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>意<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>思<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">si</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>位<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>显<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>现<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>添<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>量<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>痛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tònɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>更<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>恳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kěn</rt></ruby><ruby>切<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qiè</rt></ruby>，<ruby>汗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hàn</rt></ruby><ruby>珠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhū</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>血<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xuè</rt></ruby><ruby>点<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>滴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dī</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>完<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wán</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>忧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yōu</rt></ruby><ruby>愁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chóu</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>睡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>觉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>祷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>免<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Miǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>入<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rù</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>迷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mí</rt></ruby><ruby>惑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huo</rt></ruby>！”

<ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>。<ruby>那<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>十<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>二<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">èr</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>门<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mén</rt></ruby><ruby>徒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tú</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>走<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby><ruby>头<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>近<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>嘴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǐ</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 耶稣被捕

verses.text: <ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby></mark>！<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>嘴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>暗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">àn</rt></ruby><ruby>号<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hào</rt></ruby><ruby>卖<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mài</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”

<ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>砍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>刀<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dāo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>削<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiāo</rt></ruby><ruby>掉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>耳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ěr</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dé</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>个<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡe</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby>！<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>晓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>得<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby>！”<ruby>正<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby>，<ruby>鸡<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>叫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiào</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>还<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hái</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>许<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>别<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bié</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>话<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huà</rt></ruby><ruby>辱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>骂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mà</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>天<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tiān</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yí</rt></ruby><ruby>亮<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby><ruby>间<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiān</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>老<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>连<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lián</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>文<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wén</rt></ruby><ruby>士<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>聚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jù</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>公<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>会<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huì</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby>，

verses.text: <ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>诉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">su</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>信<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìn</rt></ruby>；

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>若<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ruò</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>今<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jīn</rt></ruby><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>后<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hòu</rt></ruby>，<ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>坐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>权<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">quán</rt></ruby><ruby>能<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>右<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biɑn</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>样<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>　<ruby>神<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Hé</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>证<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhènɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>呢<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ne</rt></ruby>？<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>口<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>亲<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qīn</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>，<ruby>把<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>解<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiě</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>面<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miàn</rt></ruby><ruby>前<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qián</rt></ruby>，

verses.text: <ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>告<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡào</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>诱<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>惑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby>，<ruby>禁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby><ruby>止<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>纳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nà</rt></ruby><ruby>税<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuì</rt></ruby><ruby>给<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡěi</rt></ruby><ruby>凯<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Kǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>撒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>自<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zì</rt></ruby><ruby>己<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>基<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jī</rt></ruby><ruby>督<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dū</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>王<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wánɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”<ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>稣<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sū</rt></ruby><ruby>回<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huí</rt></ruby><ruby>答<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dá</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>对<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duì</rt></ruby><ruby>祭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jì</rt></ruby><ruby>司<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>长<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>众<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>查<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chá</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>什<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shén</rt></ruby><ruby>么<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">me</rt></ruby><ruby>罪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuì</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>但<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dàn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>越<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuè</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>力<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>煽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shān</rt></ruby><ruby>惑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huò</rt></ruby><ruby>百<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>姓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xìnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>犹<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yóu</rt></ruby><ruby>太<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tài</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>遍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>传<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuán</rt></ruby><ruby>道<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>直<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhí</rt></ruby><ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dào</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>里<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。”

<mark class="pn"><ruby>彼<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>拉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lā</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yī</rt></ruby><ruby>听<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tīnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>见<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiàn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>就<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiù</rt></ruby><ruby>问<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèn</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><mark class="pn"><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby><ruby>利<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lì</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>吗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mɑ</rt></ruby>？”
